notes: New: the app now updates itself. While it is open it checks every ~10 seconds whether the sheet or the Drive files changed, and loads the new requests by itself (a small "N new requests" message shows). It also checks the moment you come back to the app. New Refresh button on Home (top right, with "Updated 10:32") to read the latest from the sheet and Drive on demand. Needs Live.gs + the new Api.gs pasted in Apps Script (steps in deliver/live/SETUP_STEPS_LIVE.md).
